policy: No formula becomes canonical until Jamie Jones and Austin Wallace approve the decision item.

decisions.integration_rule: Centralize a versioned weight set after approval; keep the golden outputs on the current Wally weights until then.

decisions.wallyapps: Hitting: BIP and EV>=95 and LA 5..35. Pitching: BIP and EV>=95 and LA 5..40, plus Fall-2025 calibration and a 2026-02-27..2026-03-01 exclusion path.
decisions.base: BIP and ((EV>=95 and LA 5..30) or (EV>=105 and LA 5..40)).
decisions.integration_rule: Treat the definition and any historical calibration as separate, versioned rules; do not silently normalize historical outputs.

decisions.wallyapps: Core hitting/pitching zone is +/-9.97 inches and 18.29..44.08 inches; catcher framing uses +/-10 inches and 18..42 inches.
decisions.base: Leaderboard zone is approximately +/-0.83 feet and 1.6..3.5 feet with explicit grid buckets; other BASE reports use 1.5..3.5 feet.
decisions.integration_rule: Name the zones by purpose (performance, framing, display) and centralize unit conversion before sharing any rate calculation.

decisions.wallyapps: Hitting builds PA IDs from game/inning/PA fields. Pitching ensure_pa primarily starts a new PA after selected terminal pitch conditions and does not recognize KorBB='Walk' as terminal.
decisions.base: Leaderboard PA index increments on PitchofPA==1 within batter ordering.
decisions.integration_rule: Define one game-scoped PA key and one terminal-event normalizer before comparing rate or counting metrics.

decisions.wallyapps: Pitching count_statline accepts KorBB BB/IBB but not the source encoding 'Walk'; the synthetic baseline therefore records zero walks despite terminal Walk rows.
decisions.integration_rule: Preserve this observed output as a regression fixture; fix only in the shared outcome normalizer with an approved expected-output update.

decisions.wallyapps: Hitting prefers PitchType, then TaggedPitchType, AutoPitchType, PitchName, and pitch_type_canon. Pitching has paths preferring a custom PitchType and other paths preferring PitchType/Tagged/Auto.
decisions.base: BASE consumers are not yet governed by one shared pitch-type provenance field.
decisions.integration_rule: Store raw tagged, automatic, and model values separately; publish one canonical value plus provenance and confidence.

decisions.wallyapps: Pitching hard-codes D1 mean 0.011851966103058702 and standard deviation 0.04737620444754918.
decisions.base: BASE has model paths but no documented shared version contract matching these constants.
decisions.integration_rule: Move constants into a versioned model manifest with training population, date window, and model hash.

decisions.wallyapps: Pitching uses 3.214 unless FIP_CONST already exists.
decisions.base: No single project-wide FIP season/version contract was found.
decisions.integration_rule: Key the constant by season/competition and expose it in report metadata.

decisions.wallyapps: Defense standardizes called pitches and locations, evaluates stolen/lost calls and 15 split metrics, then adds D1 percentile references with minimum-chance rules.
decisions.base: BASE has catcher UI assets but no equivalent centralized framing contract identified in Step 1.
decisions.integration_rule: Extract the pure standardization and aggregation functions first; keep percentile data versioned and private-data provenance explicit.

decisions.wallyapps: Defense explodes one batted-ball row across seven position opportunities and summarizes made/missed/error outcomes and OAA-like values.
decisions.base: BASE defense UI exists, but a shared opportunity key and comparison contract are not established.
decisions.integration_rule: Keep event identity separate from player-position opportunity identity to prevent double counting at team level.

decisions.wallyapps: Called Stuff, pitch-metric, xRV, and catcher framing outputs consume local reference CSVs.
decisions.base: Private model/reference storage exists, but imported Wally artifacts do not yet share its provenance schema.
decisions.integration_rule: Require population, season window, sample thresholds, generation code, and content hash before production migration.

decisions.wallyapps: Hitting searches both data and Data; on a case-insensitive filesystem the same four fixture files load twice (736 rows rather than 368).
decisions.base: BASE data access is path/config driven.
decisions.integration_rule: Resolve and normalize absolute file paths, then deduplicate before reading; update goldens only with explicit defect-fix approval.
